The '''King's private estate''' was an area of land on the continent of [[Doxet]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]] that was owned by the [[King/Legends|king]] of [[Kingdom of Devit|Devit]]. The land within the estate contained a valley known as the [[Crystal Valley (Lazerian IV)|Crystal Valley]], which appeared barren and [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]], but in reality held numerous [[The Force|Force]]-attuned crystals known as [[Empeth Crystal]]s.<ref name="TSoK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The King's private estate was created by [[John Terra]] and introduced in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a [[1993]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TSoK" />
